description:
Plan: ../recursive-denotations-proposal.html. Stack of PRs on main: PR1 reproducers+signal, PR2 fz-tfn.62 narrow, PR3 fz-kdt.48, PR4 fz-kdt.177 kernel, PR5 fz-kdt.177 semantics.

PR3. canonicalize_tuple_axis, canonicalize_list_axis, dedupe_exact_clauses (mod.rs ~264-296, ~512-581) are three arrival-order survivor rules; canon has drop_subsumed/visit_order (survivor by rendered text, canon.rs ~552-613) and saturate (~471-483). One pass at intern: drop a clause covered by the union of its surviving siblings, visiting in ClauseOrder, plus per-axis saturation to Conj::top when the clauses cover the axis. Delete the three per-axis rules, dnf::tuple_clause_subsumed/list_clause_subsumed, and canon's drop/visit_order/saturate. Keep debug_assert_dnf_axes_hygienic aligned. Tests: a_clause_covered_by_its_siblings_is_dropped_on_every_axis, an_arrow_returning_any_saturates_the_func_axis.
title: One absorber for every axis, survivor by typed order, with saturation
